status: Controller/storage integration implemented and Linux-tested; operator UI and shipping qualification remain unfinished.
new_wire_work: Wire parser, transport, durable transaction, conditional creation and observed-durability guards are implemented. UI and packaged radio proof remain.
admission: Explicit operator begin or resume only; no mutating request on status, reconnect, timer or automatic retry.
Hold the existing per-radio provisioning lease through candidate persistence, HTTP, active-key promotion and candidate retirement.
Pin original radio control session, literal LAN address, radio serial and managed installation ID. Refuse stale sessions before network mutation.
Require the known managed owner contract and owner_key_version1; do not reuse legacy Reset or change sign-out ownership semantics.
candidate: Use CSPRNG-generated nonzero64lowerhex; namespace the independent slot by serial/installation ID.
Load an existing candidate before generating another. A pending proposal must never be overwritten with a fresh key.
Require successful persistent save plus actual keychain read-back before any server mutation. Build-level keychain availability alone does not prove durability.
Expose a narrow TokenStore current-durable predicate (exact token/revision, no session override, committed16byte version,32byte selection).
If a saved candidate has an interrupted sidecar, repair that exact observed candidate with conditional same-value replacement, then read it back. Never use a blind save to repair it.
server: Initial begin can submit the saved candidate once with the known current owner bearer.
An explicit resume first confirms using the same saved candidate as both body and bearer. That request can succeed only when it is already the current owner.
If confirmation401 arrives and an old owner is retained, any replay must be bounded to the exact saved candidate and the operator resume intent; never generate a replacement or retry on a timer.
Only a fresh strict200 receipt matching installation and SHA256(candidate) authorizes local promotion. Lost reply, malformed receipt, transport error or ambiguous outcome retains both credentials.
Old-key success during an in-flight request is not proof of rollback. A concurrent different owner may win; do not overwrite its local credential or claim ownership.
promotion: Use replaceIfCurrent against the active token/revision and exact backend selection; retain candidate if the result is uncertain or local state changed.
A lost promotion reply or process crash may leave a whole old or whole new primary with an unfinished sidecar; fresh exact observation plus matching radio confirmation must recover conditionally.

The existing replaceIfCurrent deliberately refuses a missing active entry. If a previously saved candidate is confirmed by the radio, add a SEPARATE explicit conditional-create/adoption path under the backend lease, refusing any competing primary or unknown metadata. Do not remove the existing missing-entry guard.
Retire the independent candidate only after durable active-key adoption, using its exact token/revision and conditional removal. Cleanup uncertainty must be reported truthfully.
lifetime: Window closure or process death must not lose the sole replacement: candidate storage precedes remote mutation.
A stale callback may not mutate another radio session or overwrite a newer OS credential. Keep the lease alive through actual backend completion.
No source arm, Start, receive restoration, RF, root privilege or tailnet sign-out is a side effect of this operation.
